title: taoist_with_15_dogs
description: 一款能控制亡灵生物的道教法器模组A Taoist artifact module that controls undead creatures.
body: This module adds Taoist instruments to the game. You can go to the wild to find sakura wood synthesis sakura wood board to get the first material to make peach wood sword, and then collect red stone iron ingot and ink bag synthesis cinnabar, now use stick sakura wood board and cinnabar can synthesize peach wood sword, this weapon has additional damage to the undead, in addition, paper and cinnabar can be synthesized to control the yellow amulet of the undead creature, just right biological control. Empty-handed right button can open the creature backpack, can give the creature to wear equipment to put personal items, etc. The props to control the undead creature are three clear bells synthesized with copper ingots, right button can lock the command amulet to attack the creature.
